puzzle.q: A casino pays 2ⁿ if the first head appears on toss n. The expected value is infinite — so why won't anyone pay $1,000 to play?
puzzle.a: The St. Petersburg paradox: EV is infinite but utility isn't. Log utility (or any bankroll constraint) prices the game in single digits.
